name: EUBCE European Biomass Conference and Exhibition
notes: Proceedings are published online open access by ETA-Florence (all accepted plenary, oral and poster contributions; Scopus-indexed); the scientific track is coordinated by the European Commission JRC. Covers biomass-to-energy, biofuels and SAF, and the bioeconomy - relevant to the biomass WTE, BECCS, biochar, pyrolysis/HTL and cellulosic-ethanol cards. Evidence: eubce.com and new.etaflorence.it/events/eubce, read 2026-10-29. Terms and automated-access reality to be recorded on first collection. CORRECTED 2026-10-30: proceedings (2013-2026 editions, 500-600 contributions each) are open access AFTER FREE REGISTRATION at etaflorence.it/proceedings (search by edition/topic/author; DOIs issued, ISSN 2282-5819); 2010-2012 editions are paid CD/DVD. Downloads therefore need a registered account - collectors will not register; batch collection waits for the owner to register and drop PDFs in corpus/_inbox/eubce/.
